content: This document provides a summary of information about the medication and does not include all possible details. It does not guarantee that the medication is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this medication and your specific health needs. Uses: This medication is prescribed to treat chronic viral infections of the liver, specifically hepatitis B. It works by slowing the replication of the virus, thereby reducing the amount of the virus in your body. How to Use: Before starting this medication, read the patient information leaflet provided by your pharmacist. Do this again each time you get a refill. Take this medication orally, with or without food, as directed by your doctor, usually once daily. To maximize its benefits, take the medication regularly and at the same time each day. Do not increase, decrease, or stop the dosage without consulting your doctor or pharmacist. This medication is not suitable as a standalone treatment for patients co-infected with hepatitis B and HIV. HIV testing is recommended before and during treatment to ensure appropriate therapy. Be aware that your condition may worsen, or the virus may become resistant during or after treatment. Side Effects: Common side effects may include weakness, headache, fever, increased cough, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or gas. This medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the risks of side effects. Serious allergic reactions to this drug are rare. However, this is not a complete list of possible side effects. Contact your doctor for medical advice if you experience any concerning symptoms. Precautions: Inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to this medication or have any other allergies. The product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. Use this medication during pregnancy only if clearly needed. It is unknown if the drug passes into breast milk. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not list all possible drug interactions. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Overdose: In case of overdose with serious symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Preventing Hepatitis B Transmission: To prevent spreading hepatitis B to others, practice safer sex by using effective barrier methods such as latex condoms or dental dams during sexual activity. Do not share needles. Monitoring: Regular lab and medical tests (e.g., kidney and liver function, HIV tests) may be conducted while you are taking this medication. Continue these tests during and for several months after treatment. Keep all lab and medical appointments as scheduled. Missed Dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Storage: Store the medication in its original container at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Notes: This document is a summary and does not contain all possible information about this product. It does not ensure that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this medication and your specific health needs.
